Select Zurich Takaful (Comprehensive) and click [Buy]

At Takaful Details, click [Plan Details]

From Secarang main page, enter vehicle details and click [Get Quotation]
Select Zurich Takaful (Comprehensive) and click [Buy]
Choose add-ons and click [Continue]
At Takaful Details, click [Info] ('i' symbol) at the 'Excess' row
Observe the details of the additional information
column6:
Ensure the Excess Info has the following:

Compulsory Excess / Excess / Damage Claim 

This refers to an additional excess amount that you, as policy holder, would be required to bear, in the event of a claim.

The relevance of this excess depends on specific circumstances of the authorised driver at the time of the accident.

Here are some instances as to why compulsory excess applies to you:
Below 21 years old
Holds an L license
Held a full license for less than 2 years
